goal: Say thick / thin about round things and wide / narrow about flat things and openings, see that whether a thing goes through a gap depends on how thick or wide it is, not how long, and put three things in order from the thinnest.
cover: Little Mole pushes a short fat wooden barrel that is stuck in a narrow wooden garden gate, while Fox, surprised, holds a long thin stick that has just passed through the gate; Deer stands beside them smiling; a sunny garden with vegetable beds.
